author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

This PR was motivated by crashes seen in e.g. https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52278#issuecomment-6449740691 and likely in https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-ppd/monitoring-operation/special-relvals-requests/-/work_items/313#note_12613491 . The problem is that the legacy `TDirectoryFile::Get()` method returns `TObject*`, but `RNTuple` does not inherit from `TObject`, and thus the `dynamic_cast` results in undefined behavior (one could argue `TDirectoryFile::Get()` returning something else than `nullptr` in such a case is already a problem).

The first commit fixes a bug in `SparseReadCache`'s check on the existence of branchListIndexes branch that was caught by the removal of the non-templated `Get()` from the `InputFile`.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2475

#### PR validation:

In a local test reading RNTuple file with `PoolSource` fails with an exception
```
----- Begin Fatal Exception 27-Oct-2026 16:03:47 CDT-----------------------
An exception of category 'WrongFileFormat' occurred while
   [0] Constructing the EventProcessor
   [1] Constructing input source of type PoolSource
Exception Message:
The ROOT file does not contain a TTree named Events
 This is either not an edm ROOT file or is one that has been corrupted.
----- End Fatal Exception -------------------------------------------------
```

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

First commit possibly to be backported.
title: Avoid crash when PoolSource reads an RNTuple file, and fix check for existence of branchListIndexes in `SparseReadCache`
